svg.title: The positive two-point representation gives monotonicity in positive Euclidean time before the short-distance limit is known. The comparison can be selected inside any proposed sequence of radii on the same table and phase. Monotonicity sandwiches nearby generic distances around each selected radius; applying this to a hypothetical violating sequence proves the full right-hand limit. A single favorable scaling subsequence would not suffice for this step. Use the selected character vacuum of the same hierarchy and its conserved physical stress tensor.
